expectations.text: States EN 18286:2026 (AI quality management, supporting Article 17) became the first AI Act harmonised standard cited in the OJEU, announced October 15, 2026
expectations.evidence: States the opposite: "None had been cited in the Official Journal as a harmonised standard as of my knowledge"; only notes prEN 18286 reached public enquiry.

expectations.text: Explains citation in the OJEU gives a presumption of conformity for the covered requirements
expectations.evidence: "Art. 40: compliance with harmonised standards cited in the OJ gives presumption of conformity with the corresponding requirements."

expectations.text: Notes the broader standardisation request deadline was revised to February 2027
expectations.evidence: Says the deadline "was moved to roughly the end of 2025 and slipped further"; the February 2027 revision is never stated.

expectations.text: Mentions further standards (such as risk management) are still in the pipeline
expectations.evidence: "drafts on trustworthiness framework, risk management, and data/datasets work followed"; "several deliverables are expected in 2027"

expectations.text: States the high-risk application dates (December 2, 2027 for Annex III; August 2, 2028 for Annex I) run independently of standards progress
expectations.evidence: "The deal... fixed dates rather than a floating trigger: roughly 2 December 2027 for Annex III high-risk systems and 2 August 2028 for Annex I"
